title: Thinning the Wolves
summary: Wolf sign has been found at the edge of Thistledown: tracks too big for a dog and fences torn outward. Oswin Fleece wants 2 of them dealt with.
offer_text: "The wolves have come closer to Thistledown each night: howling closer every night. Go to the edge and thin them out, before someone is hurt."
turn_in_text: "Quieter already. I will sleep tonight. A little."

stages.title: Go to the edge of town

objectives.text: Go to where the wolves were seen
Tell Oswin Fleece it is done

relationship.label: Kept the wolves from the edge
